title: MiniCollab — scoped hybrid showcase (faculty policy example)

criteria.title: Problem and scope
criteria.description: Assess the problem, intended users, objectives, constraints and coherent scope.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed evidence shows no coherent problem or objectives.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Problem is vague or objectives largely unclear.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Problem and main objectives understandable; important constraints or users omitted.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Clear problem, objectives and scope with only minor gaps.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Precise and justified problem, user needs, measurable objectives and realistic constraints.

criteria.title: Report quality and clarity
criteria.description: Assess organization, clarity, specificity, and accurate separation of claims, plans and measured results.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed report is substantially incoherent or misrepresents critical results.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Major organization or clarity gaps make understanding difficult.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Readable and structured, but limited specificity or evidence presentation.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Clear, organized, specific report with minor gaps.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Excellent organization, precise technical communication, and transparent evidence and limitations.

criteria.title: Architecture and technical design
criteria.description: Assess design decisions, appropriate technology, interfaces/data model and explanation of trade-offs.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed design is incoherent or unsuitable for the stated problem.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Major unexplained design choices or missing components.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Reasonable architecture with basic component/data explanation.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Coherent design with justified choices and relevant trade-offs.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Well-justified architecture, interfaces and data model with explicit constraints and trade-offs.

criteria.title: Implementation and engineering quality
criteria.description: Assess source-supported implementation, maintainability, appropriate structure and security/reliability handling; do not equate heuristic indicators to marks.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed source demonstrates substantial implementation deficiencies.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Major source-supported engineering problems or incomplete design realization.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Core implementation is plausible with significant engineering gaps.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Source-supported implementation is coherent, with minor or bounded concerns.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Source-supported implementation demonstrates strong structure and robust handling of relevant concerns.

criteria.title: Selected functional scenario success
criteria.description: Score the outcomes of the explicitly selected reviewed scenarios only. Attribution and scope require teacher review.

criteria.title: Selected unauthenticated access check
criteria.description: Score the outcomes of the explicitly selected reviewed scenarios only. Attribution and scope require teacher review.

criteria.title: Selected database postcondition check
criteria.description: Score the outcomes of the explicitly selected reviewed scenarios only. Attribution and scope require teacher review.

criteria.title: Testing strategy and limitations
criteria.description: Assess the documented validation strategy, including clear expected outcomes, negative checks and honest limitations. Do not score executed correctness or penalize missing execution here.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Reviewed text contains no meaningful validation strategy or substantially misrepresents what was tested.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Very limited scenarios or no clear expected outcomes.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Useful scenarios and some expected outcomes, but incomplete negative cases or reproducibility details.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Clear representative scenarios and expected outcomes with explicit limitations and some negative checks.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Comprehensive requirements-linked strategy with concrete oracles, negative cases, reproducibility details and honest limitations.

criteria.title: Research and use of sources
criteria.description: Assess the assignment-required literature or documented technical sources, their relevance and use. If the assignment does not require this, explicitly exclude.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.descriptor: Required sources are demonstrably absent or irrelevant after review.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Minimal or poorly connected source use.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.descriptor: Relevant sources cited but synthesis or coverage limited.

levels.label: Strong
levels.descriptor: Relevant sources integrated and limitations understood.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Well-chosen, critically synthesized sources supporting the project with transparent provenance.
